title: Towards Ethics by Design in Online Abusive Content Detection
base_benchmarks: Kaggle Toxicity by Jigsaw and Google
Kaggle Unintended Bias in Toxicity dataset
findings: The paper uses religion as a key example to argue for a nuanced abuse detection framework. It highlights the difficulty in distinguishing between legitimate criticism of a religion (e.g., Islam) and hateful attacks against its followers (e.g., Muslims), proposing that a two-dimensional approach (subject matter and severity) is necessary to handle such cases.

measurement_description: Detection of abusive content targeting religious identity groups by classifying the text's subject matter (including religion) and its severity score. The framework is designed to distinguish between acceptable criticism of a religion and harmful attacks on its adherents.
